The plate is about 26 cm across, which is roughly 360 px in the photo, so about 14 px per cm.

The toast is a triangular slice about 11 cm long and 6 cm wide at its widest. Its area is roughly 40 cm², and at about 1.2 cm thick the volume is around 45 cm³. Bread is airy, so the weight comes to roughly 25 g. It looks like a half slice of bread with a white spread and a dark round topping.

The white topping looks like cream cheese or a similar spread. I estimate about 15 g at roughly 250 kcal/100 g.

The dark round topping is about 65 px across, or 4.5 cm. It is probably a jam or a dark glossy blob, perhaps an olive or a date, but it looks like a jam dollop. I estimate 15 g at about 250 kcal/100 g. The few green slivers are chives, at about 1 g.

I counted the bread slice as 25 g, which is on the small side, so I raised it to 30 g.
